\caption{\textbf{Agreement between SynLethDB labels and the external screens.} On the screen pairs that SynLethDB labels, AUROC of the screen phenotype (sign-flipped so that higher is more SL-like; 0.5 = no agreement) for SynLethDB SL vs screened non-SL pairs, and Spearman correlation between the label and the phenotype. SL pairs are split by the cell line(s) SynLethDB reports for them (K562 for Adamson and Gilbert, RPE-1 for Corn); every row uses all screened non-SL pairs as negatives. 95\% CIs: percentile bootstrap over pairs ($B=1000$); $\Delta$: paired bootstrap of the difference, $p \le 0.002$ for all three (Holm-adjusted $0.006$). The pair bootstrap treats pairs as independent although they share genes; a gene-level bootstrap gives wider intervals (Appendix), under which the Adamson-GI $\Delta$ is not significant ($p=0.11$). SynLethDB lists no SL pair in RPE-1. Gilbert is an in-distribution check: SynLethDB's SL calls for its pairs come from the same CRISPRi map \citep{Horlbeck2018}.}
